commit.message: fix(mike): gate delegates Coherence Delta parsing to the CI checker [impact-checked]

intent: Make Merge Master Mike's gate accept every Coherence Delta format the CI checker accepts by delegating parsing to scripts/governance/check_pr_coherence_delta.py (single source of truth), including label aliases, bold-colon-inside labels, HTML-comment stripping, 'none' as a substantive drift answer, and the PR-comment fallback. Operator-ratified 2026-07-27 (merge approval protocol decision 2) and 2026-07-31 (repo-wide automerge ratification clause 3; receipt at ~/.dharma/witness/merge_approval/ratification_20260731_repo_wide_automerge.md).

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, sys; src = Path('scripts/governance/check_pr_coherence_delta.py'); bak = src.with_suffix('.negctl'); src.rename(bak); result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts/runtime\"); import pr_merge_control as prc; prc.coherence_results(\"- Organ touched: x\")'], check=False, capture_output=True, text=True); bak.rename(src); sys.exit(0 if result.returncode != 0 else 1)"
negative_controls.name: gate-fails-closed-without-ci-checker

honest_blockers: Red proof captured pre-fix: 4 new tests failed against the divergent gate parser (bold-colon-inside, CI aliases, 'none' drift answer, comment fallback).

The gate's comment-fallback fetch degrades to body-only validation on gh API failure; this is additive-only and never stricter than the pre-change gate, but comment-sourced acceptance depends on live gh access.
Local receipt head-freshness (packet-vs-current head for LOCAL receipts) is out of scope for this packet; native GitHub review bridging remains head-SHA-bound as before.
This packet does not change required reviewers, risk policy, HOT_PATH_PATTERNS, or any workflow; the copilot-requirement change is a separate packet.
Packet preflight ran after edits, not before: this packet was authored mid-change in a fresh worktree; closeout is the binding evaluation.
INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.md has no entry for the gate/CI-checker pair; none added.
